[Question]
Before Xiao Li looks carefully, how many golden retrievers does he guess there are?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Before Xiao Li looks carefully, he guesses there are 19 golden retrievers.
B. Before Xiao Li looks carefully, he guesses there are 18 golden retrievers.
C. Before Xiao Li looks carefully, he guesses there are 20 golden retrievers.
D. Before Xiao Li looks carefully, he guesses there are 10 golden retrievers.
